question: According to LERMS policy, what percentage of foreign exchange earnings was required to exchange at the official exchange rate as determined by the RBI?
solution:
The correct answer is __**40%.**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• **LERMS( Liberalized Exchange Rate Management System)** was a new exchange rate operation system.
